newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share volume slips, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share volume slips, prices mixed.

text.p: Latvian share volumes slipped on Wednesday with prices mixed, the bourse said.
Overall market volume fell to 103,000 lats versus 111,189 lats on Tuesday. Official list shares Unibanka and Staburadze confectionery maintained a steady rise.

Commercial bank indices rose slightly, with the Rietumu Bank index, tracking all shares, rising 0.5 percent to 149.16 while Saules Bank's Saule10. which follows the 10 most liquid stocks, rose 0.67 percent to 150.98.
Unibanka registered activity of 47,223 lats and remained stable at 3.25 lats.
Staburadze turned over 14,555 lats of shares and gained four santimes to 2.60 lats.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain maker was most active as it saw shares worth 6,985 lats change hands, a drop from 43,442 lats. It closed a notch higher at 2.16 against 2.14.
Mangali Shipyard registered activity of 3,433 lats as it fell 10 santimes to 95 santimes.

Elsewhere on the secondary list, Salacgriva fish cannery turned over 1,900 lats of shares and fell to 4.59 lats from 4.70 lats and Lode Brick maker had volume of 1,894 lats as it fell seven santimes to 1.90 lats.
Riga Light equipment factory registered activity of 1,758 lats and closed seven santimes higher at 59 santimes.
